verdict.rationale: Moosend's pricing page lists a first-party transactional capability for 'high-priority, event-driven emails such as order confirmations and password resets,' which sits alongside its marketing campaign features. Nothing in the evidence shows these are sent through a developer API, so the core developer-facing part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of a transactional send API (endpoints, auth, per-recipient sends), coverage of magic links and receipts specifically, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends

citations.quote: Enable high-priority, event-driven emails such as order confirmations and [password resets](#).
